ॡ: ॡ The long vowel corresponding to the preceding short one, Ḹ of Ḷ.

ॡ aptote. 1 A divine female. 2 The female nature. 3 A mother. m. (-ॡः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ॡः) 1 The mother of the demons. 2 The mother of the all-bestowing cow. ind. A mystical letter used once or repeatedly in many Mantras or mystical formulae. The letter ॠ and ऌ are employed in the same manner: they have apparently no signification, but are personified and invested with marvellous properties in the Tantras. ए
